target_moa.text: Emapalumab is an IgG1 monoclonal antibody that binds and neutralizes free and receptor-bound interferon gamma (IFNγ), a cytokine whose elevated levels are a hallmark of HLH

citations.quote: Emapalumab is an IgG1 monoclonal antibody against interferon gamma (\text{IFN}\gamma).
Emapalumab is an IgG1 immunoglobulin that binds and neutralizes free and receptor-bound interferon gamma (IFN\gamma).

High levels of IFN\gamma, in addition to other cytokines associated with inflammation, is one of the hallmarks of HLH and therefore targeting and neutralization of IFN\gamma is a proposed treatment modality for HLH.

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (≥20%): infections (56%), hypertension (41%), infusion-related reactions (27%), and pyrexia (24%). Serious adverse reactions were reported in 53% of patients. The most common serious adverse reactions (\ge 3\%) included infections, gastrointestinal hemorrhage, and multiple organ dysfunction. Fatal adverse reactions occurred in two (6%) of patients and included septic shock and gastrointestinal hemorrhage.

In 32% of patients receiving GAMIFANT in clinical trials, serious infections such as sepsis, pneumonia, bacteraemia, disseminated histoplasmosis, necrotizing fasciitis, viral infections, and perforated appendicitis were observed.
